verdict.rationale: Slack presents Slackbot as a personal AI agent that you ask to do things, such as updating deals, analyzing reports, creating briefs and handling open-ended questions. Its official MCP server also lets AI clients search channels, send and draft messages, manage canvases and lists, and upload files from natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and first-party documentation of exactly which in-product actions Slackbot can perform (the evidence is mostly marketing-level).
